sophia (arch): Quick sync - we need to lock down the policy bundle + runtime contract for smart routing. Main goals: predictable latency, clear ownership, and debuggable telemetry.

mike (infra): Short list of tradeoffs: 1) richer remote policy = more expressiveness but adds RPC latency; 2) compiled local bundle = fast eval but harder to rollout.

anna (pm): Can we propose a minimal call/response shape that supports telemetry and explainability? Product needs to surface it.

sophia (arch): Thumbnailed decision return shape: 

RouteDecision: route_id (string), variant (string), score (float), reason_code (string), debug_token? (string)

Reason_code should be a short stable enum (e.g. "REGION_PREF", "CAPACITY_FALLBACK", "PENALTY_THRESHOLD"). Full human-readable explanations go to debug store keyed by debug_token.

neal (ops): Telemetry tags for every routing decision: policy_version, decision_path (local|remote|fallback), decision_latency_ms, route_id, tenant_id, region, policy_owner (bundle|service). Also emit boolean cache_hit. Sample full explanations at 0.1% by default.

katie (eng): Runtime needs a local cache of signed bundles for offline/fast eval. Bundle metadata must include bundle_version, signed_by, ttl, and required_runtime_version. Runtime validates signature and rejects incompatible bundles.

mike (infra): Implementation idea: policy.bundle.v1 is a compact artifact with precompiled matchers + a small evaluation VM. Target eval time for in-process bundle: p99 < 2ms (aim p50 < 200us). Remote RPC used only on cache miss or explicit missing capability.

anna (pm): Rollout concerns: how do we avoid breaking older runtimes when we change semantics (new reason_code or new matching primitives)? We need compatibility guarantees.

sophia (arch): Compatibility rules proposal: 1) Bundles must remain compatible for two runtime releases (semver policy). 2) Each bundle advertises min_runtime_version and feature_flags. 3) Policy-engine will not flip traffic to a new bundle until all runtime fleets report bundle_install_ok. Hosted customers: orchestrated rollout.

neal (ops): On telemetry storage cost - don't store verbose explanation per request. Use short codes and debug_token flow: write sampled explanations to a debug-store and keep only code in main metrics. Debug-token resolves the full payload with RBAC.

katie (eng): Additions: decision_canary_id and per-tenant trace_sampling_rate inside the bundle. Provide a debug HTTP endpoint /policy/debug?req=<id>&token=<dbg> that returns the sampled explain payload if allowed.

mike (infra): Operational SLOs: in-process bundle eval p99 < 2ms; remote decision p99 < 15ms. On remote failure/timeouts, runtime should apply deterministic fallback: last-known-good bundle or simple heuristic (region->cost stable mapping). Also emit metric routing.decision.fallback_applied.

anna (pm): UX: Console must surface policy_version timeline, percent traffic by variant, and sample explains. Also a rollout state (pending/active/failed) and last bundle hash deployed per region.

neal (ops): Metrics to add now: routing.decision.latency_ms, routing.decision.cache_hit, routing.decision.remote_failures, routing.decision.explain_samples, routing.decision.fallback_applied. Tag keys: policy_version, route_id, tenant_id, region, decision_path.

katie (eng): Security: bundles signed with rotating keys; runtime verifies signatures and accepts only bundles signed by our policy-keys. RPC uses mTLS + tenant-scoped JWT. Debug tokens are short-lived and audited.

sophia (arch): Proposed action items:
1) Short RFC: RouteDecision schema, reason_code enum, debug-token workflow, bundle metadata (signed, version, min_runtime).
2) Telemetry spec: tagset, sampling rates (0.1% full explains, default 5% for aggregated reason counts), metric names.
3) Prototype: policy.bundle.v1 artifact + runtime verifier/cache and perf harness.
4) Console: rollout UI + sampled explain viewer + policy timeline.

mike (infra): I'll sketch bundle internals and run a microbenchmark across typical model selection workloads.

anna (pm): I'll mock Console panels and write rollout/playbook notes for hosted vs dedicated.

neal (ops): I'll draft SLOs and alerts (fallback spikes, cache miss burst, remote failure rate).

katie (eng): I'll build the runtime verifier + debug endpoint prototype and pair with Mike.

deploy-bot: deploy status: no deploys in last 24h.

sophia (arch): If nobody objects to the bundle + signature model or the idea of compact reason_codes + debug_token flow, I'll open the RFC with these action items. Call out anything urgent here. :thumbsup:
